# CTRL

> Web system designed for any modern device with a browser. CTRL apps can perform complex tasks more easily than native apps by simulating an abstract virtual system within the browser.

CTRL is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/CTRL/blob/HEAD/README.md): install, usage and reference

- [Run it.](https://github.com/nirholas/CTRL/blob/HEAD/README.md#run-it)
- [Making CTRL Apps](https://github.com/nirholas/CTRL/blob/HEAD/README.md#making-ctrl-apps)
- [Let's Connect!](https://github.com/nirholas/CTRL/blob/HEAD/README.md#lets-connect)
- [Documentation](https://github.com/nirholas/CTRL/blob/HEAD/README.md#documentation)

- [Full text for LLMs](https://github.com/nirholas/CTRL/blob/HEAD/llms-full.txt): the README inlined
